hypothesis.statement: A full Core construction can represent exact replay, mismatch fresh fallback, and missing fresh fallback without treating fallback as replay or rejecting a valid construction.
hypothesis.highest_value_reason: The current Core binding path can discard a mismatched transcript and execute fresh, but the construction proof still requires captured=consumed and forbids transport in the replay wrapper; this blocks the only authorized replacement V7 probe.

paths_under_test.exact: captured transcript request equals Native request; consume exactly once; no fresh transport
paths_under_test.mismatch: captured candidate exists but request identity differs; do not consume candidate; discard it once; execute exactly one fresh Native transport
paths_under_test.missing: no transcript candidate exists; consume zero; execute exactly one fresh Native transport
paths_under_test.fresh_failure: fresh fallback transport fails; no durable publication or success seal
paths_under_test.duplicate: duplicate consume/capture is rejected, never silently converted to success
paths_under_test.serialization_mismatch: prompt/request serialization mismatch is a mismatch and follows fresh fallback

definitions.captured: logical transcripts captured by the prepare phase
definitions.exact_consumed: transcripts consumed by exact replay only
definitions.discarded_unconsumed: unconsumed candidates removed after mismatch fallback
definitions.remaining_unconsumed: unconsumed transcripts at scope finalization; must be zero for success
definitions.mismatch_fallback: fresh authoritative call after identity mismatch
definitions.missing_fallback: fresh authoritative call with no candidate transcript
definitions.fresh_failure: fallback attempt that fails before publication

transport_contract.mismatch_or_missing_fallback: external_transport_attempted=true and transport_attempt_count=1 on success, with the real NATIVE admission class
transport_contract.provider_retry: not an independent replicate; record every physical attempt and retry reason

success: exact consume and fresh fallback are distinct
artifact can be sealed from frozen manifest
failure: fresh provider failure prevents durable publication
duplicate or serialization mismatch is rejected or fresh-fallback accounted
invalid: proof fields disagree with observed provider calls

required_tests: full construction intentional mismatch with one fresh call
full construction missing transcript with one fresh call
fresh fallback failure has no publication
existing ordered publication and no-write tests
historical V6.1 strip behavior remains unchanged

required: exact, missing, mismatch accounting is consistent
fresh fallback is not marked replay
all relevant targeted and full test suites pass
artifact identity and manifest are reproducible
phase0_gate.on_failure: remain in Phase 0 and fix one falsifiable issue at a time; do not run provider/V7 experiments

forbidden_actions: provider/live V7 experiment before Phase 0 qualification
